newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Volunteer bus in Venezuela hits truck, 12 killed.
newsitem.headline: Volunteer bus in Venezuela hits truck, 12 killed.

text.p: A bus carrying religious volunteers slammed into a truck in central Venezuela on Sunday killing at least 12 people and injuring 16, emergency authorities said.
The accident occurred near the town of Caucagua, 50 miles (80 km) east of Caracas in the early hours of Sunday, a Civil Defence official said.
The bus passengers were on their way to a religious festival in eastern Venezuela, he said. No further details were immediately available.
